test_token_embedding_produces_correct_em: test that token embeddings produce correct one-hot embeddings into the token subspace of residual_space
test_position_embedding_produces_correct: test that position embeddings produce correct one-hot embeddings into the indices subspace of residual_space
test_unembedding: test that unembedding recovers original tokens from embeddings using argmax over the output subspace
build_embedding_modules: build embedding modules with token_embed, pos_embed, and unembed using _make_embedding_modules from assemble
assemble_transformer_model: assemble a transformer model from a craft residual stack with assembled weights and parameters
